name: Melissa "Mel" Shinkle
occupation: Teton County assessor (serving through the current term, which ends in January 2027)
prior_offices: Teton County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; listed on the official assessor page)
background: Melissa "Mel" Shinkle is the Teton County assessor, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. She won the November 2022 general election. The Jackson Hole News&Guide reported that she opted against seeking another term. Incoming assessor Ashlee Nader takes office in January 2027.

sources.name: Jackson Hole News&Guide, Nov. 4, 2026, Ashlee Nader wins race for Teton County assessor
